coreResponsibility.summary: A Kaltura Player plugin that provides OTT (Over-The-Top) analytics tracking by sending bookmark events to the Kaltura OTT backend to track playback progress, user engagement, and session management.

featureOwnership: OTT Bookmark event tracking (LOAD, PLAY, PAUSE, STOP, FINISH, FIRST_PLAY, BITRATE_CHANGE, HIT)
Media playback position tracking for VOD and live streams
Concurrency limit detection and error handling
Anonymous user detection and reporting control
Recording and EPG (Electronic Program Guide) ID handling
Program ID tracking for recordings, catchup, and start-over content
dataHandling: Bookmark objects (type, context, id, position, playerData, programId)
Player state tracking (isPlaying, isLoaded, isFinished, isStopped, didFirstPlay)
Event parameters (mediaType, contextType, fileId, mediaId, position)
OTT metadata from player sources (mediaType, contextType, recordingId, epgId)
Session data (ks - Kaltura Session token, partnerId, entryId)

upstream.name: @playkit-js/kaltura-player-js
upstream.description: Core Kaltura Player - provides player instance, events, BasePlugin class, and core utilities

upstream.name: @playkit-js/playkit-js-providers
upstream.description: Provider layer - supplies OTTBookmarkService and RequestBuilder for backend communication

downstream.name: Kaltura OTT Backend
downstream.description: Receives bookmark analytics data via OTTBookmarkService.add() API calls

downstream.name: Kaltura Player Applications
downstream.description: OTT-based video applications that integrate this plugin for analytics tracking

externalApis.name: Kaltura OTT Bookmark Service API
externalApis.description: Backend API endpoint for adding bookmark entries (playback progress, events)
externalApis.endpoint: Configured via serviceUrl in plugin config

sourceOfTruth.description: Main entry point - exports OttAnalytics class and registers plugin with Kaltura Player
Core plugin implementation - contains OttAnalytics class with all bookmark tracking logic

configuration.description: Flow type definitions for plugin configuration options

output.description: Built distribution file exposed as playkit.ottanalytics

errorSignatures: block report because of missing param
No service URL provided. Tracking aborted

configurationOptions.mediaHitInterval: Interval in seconds between periodic HIT events (default: 30)
configurationOptions.isAnonymous: Whether user is anonymous - blocks all reporting if true (default: true)
configurationOptions.disableMediaHit: Disable periodic HIT event reporting (default: false)
configurationOptions.experimentalEnableLiveMediaHit: Enable MediaHit for live streams (default: false)
